verdicts.detail: Every stated output format is written by the viewer: FASTA (.fasta, lines 10167/10239), RTF (.rtf, line 11438), SVG (.svg, line 11290), Newick with the .nwk extension (.nj.nwk/.upgma.nwk, line 15098), and a standalone HTML snapshot (_snapshot.html, line 10991). MSF is input only: line 19801 lists '.msf' among input validExtensions, and every other 'msf'/'MSF' reference in the code is parsing/validation (e.g. lines 4920-4921, 8407, 8719-8722) with NO MSF writer/export function. (PNG exports come from the Tree/Dot-plot windows and the order-JSON from a separate 'Save sequence order' feature, both outside section 2.7's 'Save / Export Alignment' scope.)

The stated 'Node.js >= 16' does not match the code. package.json (29 lines) has NO 'engines' field, so no Node minimum is declared there (only name/version/description/main/scripts/keywords/author/license/homepage/repository/bugs/dependencies/devDependencies). The only version-sensitive syntax in server.js is optional chaining '?.' (lines 77, 83, 832) and nullish coalescing '??' (lines 113, 114), both stable unflagged since Node.js 14.0.0 - i.e. the code requires Node >= 14, not >= 16. A grep for Node 16+-only features (??=, ||=, &&=, .at(), Object.hasOwn, structuredClone, crypto.randomUUID, findLast, Promise.any, Array.fromAsync) found none in server.js. The stated minimum (16) differs from the code's actual minimum (14).

note: Verified 2 claims. Claim 53 (MATCH): the viewer writes FASTA (.fasta, script.js:10167/10239), RTF (.rtf, 11438), SVG (.svg, 11290), Newick with .nwk extension (.nj.nwk/.upgma.nwk, 15098), and standalone HTML snapshots (_snapshot.html, 10991); MSF appears only as input (validExtensions line 19801, no MSF export function). Claim 56 (MISMATCH): package.json has no 'engines' field; server.js uses only ?. and ?? (Node >= 14, not >= 16), and no Node 16+-only syntax is present.
